general_policy: PERC admits students after an initial counseling session and a diagnostic assessment test to understand the student's current academic level. Admission is open to all motivated students.

admission_process.title: Book a Demo
admission_process.description: Schedule a free demo class or counseling call to experience PERC teaching methodology firsthand.

admission_process.title: Visit Campus
admission_process.description: Visit the campus in Begur, Bengaluru. Meet the faculty, see the facilities, and understand PERC approach.

admission_process.title: Diagnostic Assessment
admission_process.description: Appear for a diagnostic assessment test to help PERC understand the student level and allocate the appropriate batch.

admission_process.title: Choose Program
admission_process.description: Select the right program based on academic goals. PERC counselors will help make the best choice.

admission_process.title: Start Learning
admission_process.description: Complete admission formalities and begin your learning journey with personalized attention and expert guidance.

program_eligibility.notes: Students studying under the CBSE curriculum.
Students studying under the ICSE curriculum.
Students preparing for JEE Main and JEE Advanced.

demo_class.description: Students and parents can attend a free demo class to experience PERC teaching methodology before enrolling.
